code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); pts.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in pts); r1=max(y for y,x in pts); c0=min(x for y,x in pts); c1=max(x for y,x in pts)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            if area>=10 and len(pts)/area>=0.75:
                for y in range(r0,r1+1):
                    for x in range(c0,c1+1): out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
